name: local-translation
description: Coordinate expert translation agents, draft with a local Index-Translate runner, and track queries, independent revision, and delivery evidence across target locales.

interface.longDescription: Run a professional translation workflow with a coordinating project manager, locale-specific translators, independent bilingual revisers, terminology and subject experts, and delivery checks. A bundled Python MCP tool calls an operator-configured local Index-Translate server, preserves immutable source snapshots, tracks queries and corrections, and prepares review-bound delivery candidates. Supports UTF-8 text and structured segments. Model weights and a runner are separate prerequisites; host agents may use cloud models. Audiovisual roles require additional media capabilities and verified references. Human acceptance remains separate from agent review.
defaultPrompt: Use Local Translation to plan a translation team and check my local Index-Translate setup.
Translate this guide into my target locales, with independent revision and a shared terminology query process.
Review this translation job, resolve feedback, and prepare a delivery candidate for my acceptance.
